testsuite.name: com.bontecou.syncmd.services.repositories.RepositoryLifecycleTest

testcase.name: clone publishes a validated working copy and removes its staging directory
backup inside a repository is rejected and working copy remains registered on disk
bounded scans disclose truncation and invalid working copies
clone refuses occupied destinations without deleting local content
removing tracking with backup preserves original history working files and a verified archive
a parent repository initialized after review blocks detachment
scan discovers real working copies skips bare metadata and never follows symlinks
inspection requires the exact repository root and redacts remote credentials
managed deletion rejects the root itself and external repositories and never follows links
metadata changes after review abort removal
explicit removal without backup keeps every working file
clone preserves Git symlinks as pointer files instead of staged deletions
lock files symlinks and nested repositories are rejected before detaching
a destination created during clone is preserved and only the owned staging folder is removed
